preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 2^16.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= degree_i <= n - 1 for degree_i in degrees)
preconditions.description: Each degree_i is between 0 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= s_i < 2**16 for s_i in s_values)

postconditions.description: The number of edges m is half the sum of all degrees.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) in edges and (b, a) in edges for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) appears twice in the edge list (once as (a, b) and once as (b, a)).

postconditions.expression: all(a != b for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) consists of two distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a <= n - 1 and 0 <= b <= n - 1 for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each vertex in an edge is between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.expression: all(sum((a, b) in edges for b in range(n)) == degrees[a] for a in range(n))
postconditions.description: The degree of each vertex a is equal to the number of edges incident to it.

postconditions.expression: all(reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, [b for a, b in edges if a == i], 0) == s_values[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The XOR sum of the neighbors of each vertex i is equal to s_i.
